event.notes: High-value client referral — government official, self-declared PEP

mission_description: Perform full KYC name screening for new individual customer C002 (Senator Marcus Delgado, PHL national), a self-declared Politically Exposed Person (PEP) from the Philippines. The customer is a senior government official. Apply enhanced due diligence procedures, verify identity, screen against PEP and sanctions lists, and determine the appropriate onboarding decision per HKMA AMLO requirements.
